referenceLineage: The final assets used the six-genome concept sheet as a style reference. That sheet was generated from a user-supplied Cellular Death Match screenshot as a visual reference for CA scale, palette, and black-void presentation.
commonPrompt: Final square game UI character reconstruction for Cellular Death Match. Match the reference's coarse square-cell pixel art, limited color ramps, luminous arcade biology, and expressive minimal silhouettes. Exactly one isolated full-body organism centered on a genuinely transparent background, readable as a 96px icon. No text, label, watermark, egg, UI, frame, drop shadow, smooth vector curves, antialiasing, 3D, painterly texture, detached weapon, or extra creature.
normalization: scripts/normalize-genome-art.mjs removes the generator's baked pale checkerboard, reduces each source to a coarse 48-cell raster, maps the dominant shade to the canonical in-game primary RGB, guarantees that exact RGB is the dominant visible shade, derives fixed dark/light ramps, hardens alpha, and nearest-neighbor upscales to 384 square pixels.
